name: Tug Boat 10
description: Small Grand Harbour tug, 16 m long, scuttled near Żonqor Point in Marsaskala in 1998 together with the St. Michael. Rests upright on flat sand at 21 m with its bow against the foot of the reef. Normally combined with the St. Michael, some 50 m east, and the remains of the P33.
conditions: Expect less visibility here than at most Maltese sites.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
